jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

The organization is a design, development, and support agency specializing in Drupal and WordPress platforms. It serves mission-driven clients by creating and maintaining websites that support their objectives. The company emphasizes the importance of its team members' growth, well-being, and success, recognizing that these elements contribute directly to client outcomes.

About the Opportunity:

The SENIOR WEBSITE PROJECT MANAGER role involves managing Drupal and WordPress projects across their life cycles, from initiation to completion. This position ensures effective communication, accurate project tracking, and continuous process improvement to deliver high-quality digital solutions. The role is critical in coordinating cross-functional teams and managing complex client accounts, acting as a strategic partner and advocate to maintain project clarity and quality.

Responsibilities:

Manage a portfolio of Drupal and WordPress projects, including complex and high-visibility accounts.
Serve as the primary client contact and trusted advisor, facilitating clear communication.
Align client business needs with internal teams to ensure project objectives are met.
Escalate issues appropriately and resolve challenges independently when possible.
Identify and recommend opportunities for project expansion to management.
Lead client meetings, communicate updates, and translate technical details clearly.
Oversee client onboarding, kickoff, and transitions between project phases.
Maintain organized project backlogs and prioritize tasks effectively.
Evaluate client requests for scope alignment; recommend alternatives as needed.
Perform initial site configurations and troubleshooting before involving developers.
Coordinate internal resources including developers, designers, and strategists.
Review work outputs for quality before client delivery.
Monitor budgets and timelines, providing regular progress updates.
Identify risks early and lead mitigation efforts.
Manage urgent requests and issue escalations, especially in support accounts.
Utilize tools such as Teamwork, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, and AI applications to support project management.
Lead and participate in team meetings and initiatives for process improvement.
Monitor team workload and promote sustainable work practices.
Develop and document processes to enhance project success and team satisfaction.
Mentor and support other project managers.

Requirements:

Extensive agency experience managing Drupal and/or WordPress projects.
Strong understanding of project life cycles and ability to manage both build and support efforts.
Excellent communication skills, including client interaction and team collaboration.
Ability to manage complex accounts and navigate technical challenges.
Experience with project management and communication tools.
Proven ability to lead and mentor project management teams.

The starting salary range for this role is $75,400.00 to $93,668.00, dependent on experience and skills.

This role oversees the full project lifecycle, from strategic planning and execution to modernization, operational readiness, and long-term sustainment. You will coordinate multidisciplinary teams across cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, data integration, analytics, and application support. Acting as the primary liaison between customer leadership and technical stakeholders, you will ensure priorities, deliverables, and mission objectives remain aligned. You will also drive project governance, risk management, performance reporting, and continuous improvement across multiple workstreams. This is an opportunity to contribute to mission-critical public-sector technology programs in a collaborative, technically sophisticated environment.

Lead end-to-end project planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting for enterprise IT initiatives, ensuring delivery aligns with agreed objectives, timelines, budgets, and scope.
Manage project schedules, milestones, resources, dependencies, risks, and deliverables across multiple technical workstreams.
Coordinate cross-functional teams covering engineering, cybersecurity, cloud operations, data management, analytics, and application support.

Oversee onboarding, knowledge transfer, documentation, and operational readiness activities.
Ensure the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures, technical documentation, and operational guidance.

Identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen operational efficiency, and deliver recommendations that support the customer's broader mission.

At least 10 years of experience managing complex IT programs and projects, ideally within large-scale enterprise or federal environments.

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is highly desirable.
Demonstrated success leading enterprise IT, cloud computing, digital transformation, data analytics, or technology modernization initiatives.
Experience supporting federal government or Department of Defense (DoD) customers.
Proven ability to lead and coordinate multidisciplinary technical teams in complex, matrixed organizations.

AWS GovCloud.
Cloud operations and infrastructure management.
Data lakes and data warehouses.
Tableau and Databricks.
Informatica and SAP BusinessObjects.
Oracle databases and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.
Identity and Access Management (IAM).
API integration platforms.
Azure DevOps (ADO).
Data governance, analytics, business intelligence, and reporting solutions.

Strong leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Management technischer Projekte im MEMS- oder Halbleiterumfeld bringen Sie mit.

Vil du tage ansvar for en omfattende IT-modernisering og skabe sammenhæng mellem forretning, processer og teknologi?
Recruit IT søger på vegne af Metz en erfaren og handlekraftig IT-projektleder, der kan tage ansvar for virksomhedens samlede digitale transformationsprogram – fra kortlægning og planlægning til implementering og forankring.

Metz er en familieejet virksomhed med omkring 60 medarbejdere. Gennem mange år har virksomheden udviklet systemer og arbejdsgange, der understøtter forretningen, men som i dag også skaber kompleksitet og afhængigheder.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central anvendes allerede til økonomistyring, mens Lotus Notes fortsat understøtter centrale processer inden for blandt andet lager, CRM og projektstyring.

Nu skal systemlandskabet moderniseres med ambitionen om mere sammenhængende, effektive og fremtidssikrede løsninger.
Du kommer ikke ind til et færdigt projekt med en fastlagt plan. Du skal være med til at skabe planen – og sikre, at den bliver gennemført.
Din rolle
Som IT-projektleder får du ansvaret for at planlægge, prioritere og drive det samlede transformationsprogram. Du skal sikre sammenhæng og fremdrift på tværs af projekterne og selvstændigt vurdere behovet for indsatser og kompetencer undervejs.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:
Kortlægge forretningsprocesser, systemer, integrationer og dataflows.
Indsamle og strukturere input fra forretningen og omsætte behov til konkrete systemkrav og næste skridt.
Bidrage til valg og samspil mellem ERP, CRM, lagerstyring og øvrige systemer.
Udarbejde og drive et samlet roadmap med prioriteringer, tidsplaner, ressourcer, budgetter og risici.
Drive projekterne gennem datamigrering, test, brugeraccept, idriftsættelse og overdragelse til drift.
Tage ejerskab for eksterne leverandører, koordinere interne interessenter og sikre kommunikation, oplæring og forankring.

Du skal kunne bevæge dig fra en workshop med lageret om deres daglige arbejdsgange til en teknisk dialog med en systemleverandør – og samtidig sikre, at projekterne kommer i mål.
Hvem er du?
Du har solid erfaring med IT-projektledelse eller transformationsledelse, gerne fra større ERP-implementeringer eller digitale transformationer, som du har været med til at drive fra start til slut.

Du forstår både teknologi og forretning og ved, at succesfulde IT-projekter handler lige så meget om mennesker og processer som om systemer.
Metz lægger især vægt på, at du:
Har dokumenteret erfaring med komplekse IT-projekter og gerne samlede transformationsprogrammer.
Har god forståelse for ERP, systemarkitektur, integrationer og dataflows.
Kan analysere forretningsprocesser og omsætte behov til konkrete løsninger.
Har erfaring med projektøkonomi, leverandørstyring og forandringsledelse.
Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt og skaber fremdrift, også når ikke alle svar ligger klar.

Erfaring med Business Central, CRM, WMS eller PIM er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
Metz søger ikke en udvikler eller en tung teknisk arkitekt, men en stærk projektleder med forretningsforståelse og teknisk indsigt til at drive den samlede transformation.
En rolle med reel indflydelse

Du refererer direkte til virksomhedens CFO og får en central rolle i Metz’ digitale udvikling. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med en erfaren kollega med fokus på data, BI og AI samt med forretningen og eksterne leverandører.

Metz tilbyder en uformel og familiepræget kultur med korte beslutningsveje, hvor du får mulighed for at tage ansvar, præge udviklingen og gøre en reel forskel.
Det er en stilling for dig, der motiveres af at skabe noget – og som gerne vil følge en transformation hele vejen fra de første analyser til de færdige løsninger.

jobs.title: Shipyard Project Manager
jobs.description:
Canal Barge Company

Job Description

Shipyard Project Manager

I. Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Marine Shipyard Project Manager to plan, coordinate, and execute multiple concurrent vessel maintenance, repair, overhaul, and capital improvement projects across our Gulf Inland fleet. The successful candidate will independently manage a portfolio of shipyard projects, balancing safety, regulatory compliance, vessel reliability, budgets, and schedules.

This position works closely with Port Engineers, shipyards, vendors, vessel crews, Operations, and shoreside leadership. It requires strong marine technical judgment, financial accountability, and the ability to keep several complex projects moving without continuous on-site supervision at any single location.

II. Key Responsibilities

Multi-Project Management
Manage multiple major vessel maintenance, overhaul, and capital projects simultaneously across different shipyards and locations.
Develop and maintain project scopes, schedules, budgets, milestones, risk registers, and completion plans for each assigned vessel.
Prioritize competing project demands, coordinate resources and contractors, and identify conflicts or delays early.
Maintain clear portfolio-wide visibility of progress, cost forecasts, schedule variances, open decisions, and risks; provide regular updates to Engineering leadership.
Coordinate with shipyard and vendor personnel to ensure effective daily execution without requiring continuous on-site oversight.
undefined
Pre-Docking Planning & Procurement
Participate planning meetings with vessel crews and vessel management team members to define the job scope ahead of each shipyard availability.
Write detailed job scopes for major vendors and obtain estimates.
Coordinate with shipyards to schedule dry docking and other vendor activities.
Use planned and unplanned downtime to prepare for future outages, including scheduling inspections and pre-surveys.
Enter known issues and repairs into the planned maintenance system (PMS).
Work with the inventory control and procurement team to order and deliver materials and long-lead items and move spares to the locations where they are needed.
undefined
Project Execution & Technical Oversight
Plan and execute shipyard availabilities, including Internal Structural Examinations (ISEs), Certificate of Inspection (COI) renewals, propulsion overhauls, vessel modifications, and other major repairs.
Evaluate equipment conditions, vessel deficiencies, inspection findings, and proposed repairs to establish practical, technically sound scopes of work.
Oversee vendor performance, machinery installations, structural and piping work, testing, commissioning, and project closeout.
Ensure work complies with applicable safety, quality, USCG, and other regulatory requirements and is properly documented.
Identify technical issues and determine when to resolve independently and when to escalate significant operational, compliance, or financial risks.
Hold kickoff meetings with vendors and make sure every party has the current, detailed project list.
Serve as the primary contact between the vessel operator and the shipyard.
Make sure vessel crews understand their responsibilities during each project.
When on site, meet daily with vendors to plan the day’s work and lead daily safety huddles with vendors and crew.
Perform regular quality inspections and make sure defects are corrected promptly.
Coordinate and oversee sea trials, resolve any issues found, and confirm the vessel is fully operational before handover.
Complete the vessel handover and update all project documentation accordingly.
Budget, Vendor & Cost Management
Develop cost estimates and manage approved capital and maintenance budgets for multiple concurrent projects.
Obtain and evaluate competitive proposals; assess repair recommendations and change orders for necessity, scope, cost, and value.
Track commitments, invoices, change orders, actual spending, and estimated cost to complete; communicate variances promptly.
Validate contractor billing against approved work and supporting documentation.
Control unnecessary expenditure without compromising safe, reliable, or compliant vessel operation.
Communication, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Coordinate vessel availability and return-to-service plans with Operations and other stakeholders to minimize downtime.
Provide concise, accurate project updates and maintain organized scopes, approvals, inspection records, invoices, and closeout packages.
Lead post-project reviews and apply lessons learned to improve future execution, cost control, and project consistency.

III. Measurements of Success

Asset availability: percentage of time vessels are operational and ready for service.
Maintenance cost: variance between budgeted and actual project spending.
Project completion: percentage of projects completed on time and within budget.
Continuous improvement: number and impact of process improvements put in place.

IV. Required Qualifications

Demonstrated experience successfully managing multiple concurrent marine, shipyard, or industrial capital projects with direct accountability for budgets, schedules, contractors, and closeout.
Substantial experience in marine maintenance, vessel repair, marine engineering, shipyard operations, or a comparable technical environment.
Working knowledge of diesel propulsion, auxiliary machinery, piping, and related vessel systems.
Ability to interpret drawings, technical specifications, inspection findings, and vendor proposals.
Strong financial, organizational, communication, problem-solving, and prioritization skills.
Ability to travel regularly to shipyards, vessels, and vendor locations as required.
Preferred Qualifications
Inland towboat or commercial marine shipyard project experience.
Background as a Port Engineer, Chief Engineer, Shipyard Superintendent, Marine Project Manager, or similar role.
Marine engineering degree, technical education, or equivalent practical experience.
Familiarity with USCG Subchapter M, marine inspections, diesel engine overhauls, repowering, and major vessel modifications.
Experience with computerized maintenance management and project reporting systems.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager III (6793)
jobs.description:
As Sr. Program Manager III
, you’ll lead the delivery of a complex, mission-focused technology program. You will bring together people, technology, operations, financial management, and customer engagement to ensure teams deliver measurable outcomes while maintaining strong performance and stakeholder trust.
We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed
with
our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.
If you think you can see yourself delivering our mission and pursuing our goals with us, then check out the job description below!
What you’ll do:

Program Leadership: Provide overall leadership, direction, and accountability for the successful delivery of a large-scale IT program, ensuring technical, operational, contractual, and financial objectives align with organizational and mission priorities.
Customer Engagement: Serve as the primary interface with client and organizational leadership and key stakeholders, maintaining strong customer relationships, communicating program performance, and proactively addressing priorities, concerns, and emerging requirements.
Program Execution: Plan, coordinate, and oversee program activities across cloud engineering, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, network operations, service delivery, and other technical workstreams to ensure integrated and successful execution.
Performance Management: Establish and monitor program performance metrics, service-level objectives, key performance indicators (KPIs), deliverables, and milestones to ensure contractual requirements and customer expectations are achieved.
Financial Management: Manage program budgets, forecasts, staffing, resource allocation, and financial performance while identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and maximize value to the customer.
Risk & Issue Management: Identify and manage program risks, issues, dependencies, and opportunities while developing mitigation strategies and ensuring timely escalation and resolution of critical challenges.
Workforce Management: Lead multidisciplinary teams of technical experts, engineers, architects, cybersecurity professionals, and operational personnel while ensuring appropriate staffing, performance, professional development, and workforce continuity.
Contract & Deliverable Management: Ensure contract requirements, deliverables, reporting obligations, and performance standards are met while maintaining alignment with applicable applicable policies, processes, and acquisition requirements.
Continuous Improvement: Establish processes that improve service delivery, operational maturity, automation, quality, and customer satisfaction throughout the program lifecycle.
Executive Communications: Develop and deliver program reviews, executive briefings, performance reports, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to client and corporate leadership.

What you’ll need to succeed:

Active Secret security clearance.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
15+ years of experience managing complex IT, cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, or digital modernization programs.
8+ years of experience leading large-scale programs supporting large enterprise, public sector, or regulated customers.
Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary technical teams across cloud, cybersecurity, network, infrastructure, enterprise architecture, and IT operations.
Experience managing program budgets, staffing plans, schedules, subcontractors, deliverables, performance metrics, risks, and contractual requirements.
Strong understanding of contracting, acquisition, and delivery processes, performance management, and customer engagement.
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and coordinate technical and business activities across multiple organizations and stakeholders.
Experience establishing and monitoring KPIs, SLAs, operational metrics, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Strong executive communication, leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior client and corporate leadership.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
ITIL, Agile, SAFe, or equivalent program/service management certification preferred.
Experience leading cloud modernization, Zero Trust, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, or enterprise IT transformation programs preferred.

This role will ensure HR technology is reliable, secure, well governed, scalable, and aligned with Dudek’s evolving business and workforce needs.

Working closely with Human Resources, Finance, Payroll, Benefits, IT, and other key stakeholders, the Business Operations Manager (HRIS) will serve as a critical connector between business processes and technology. The role will lead HRIS strategy and optimization, data and integration governance, system implementations and enhancements, and cross functional initiatives involving interconnected HR, ERP, financial, and enterprise systems.

The Business Operations Manager (HRIS) will also lead the HRIS team and support model, establish strong system governance and controls, and help Dudek maximize the value of its HR technology investments while supporting an effective employee and manager experience.

Candidates must be available to work during Pacific Time business hours (8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. PT).

Duties And Responsibilities

HRIS Strategy & Platform Leadership

Leads the administration, configuration, optimization, and ongoing evolution of Dayforce HCM and Dudek’s broader HR technology ecosystem.
Develops and maintains an HRIS roadmap aligned with HR priorities, enterprise technology initiatives, business growth, and evolving operational needs.
Evaluates opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve HR processes through technology while balancing business requirements, user experience, system capabilities, risk, and long-term scalability.
Maintains a strong understanding of HR technology trends, platform capabilities, and vendor roadmaps and recommends opportunities to improve Dudek’s HR technology environment.
Establishes standards and governance for HR system configuration, enhancements, testing, releases, documentation, and change management.

Enterprise Systems & Integration Leadership

Serves as the HRIS functional lead for major enterprise technology transformations, representing HR systems, employee data, integrations, controls, and workforce process requirements in cross-functional design and implementation decisions.
Serves as a key HRIS partner in the design, implementation, and ongoing optimization of integrations between Dayforce, Deltek Vantagepoint, iCIMS, and other enterprise platforms.
Partners closely with Finance and other business leaders on ERP initiatives involving employee, organizational, labor, payroll, time, project, or other shared data and processes.
Collaborates with IT, Information Security, system owners, vendors, and implementation partners to establish effective integration architecture, data flows, system dependencies, controls, and support models.
Leads HRIS participation in enterprise system implementations, upgrades, integrations, testing, data conversions, and other major technology initiatives.
Identifies and resolves complex cross-system issues, including determining root cause, coordinating stakeholders, and driving solutions through completion.
Assesses downstream impacts of system and process changes to help ensure changes made in one platform do not adversely affect interconnected systems or business processes.

Data Governance, Security & Controls

Oversees the integrity, consistency, and appropriate use of HR and employee data across HR systems and system integrations.
Establishes and maintains HRIS data governance practices, including data ownership, definitions, validation, reconciliation, and documentation, in alignment with the governance and control standards established by IT.
Administers HR system access, role-based security, and data protection practices in accordance with the security standards and controls established by IT and Information Security.
Partners with IT and Information Security to support audits, access reviews, compliance activities, and other control requirements related to HR systems and employee data.
Maintains documentation of system configurations, integrations, data flows, procedures, control activities, and key system decisions.
Monitors system and integration performance and proactively addresses risks that could affect data integrity, payroll, financial reporting, employee processes, or business operations.

HR Technology Operations & Support

Leads HR technology support through Dudek’s Business Operations service model, ensuring requests and issues are effectively prioritized, routed, resolved, and communicated.
Builds and manages the HRIS support structure in Freshservice, including intake, categorization, forms, workflows, service levels, escalation paths, and knowledge resources.
Supports iCIMS (Applicant Tracking System) and other people-related technology, including system administration, integrations, configuration, and ongoing optimization as appropriate.
Leads the HR Service Family workspace design and adoption.
Partners with Human Resources, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, and other stakeholders to translate business and process needs into sustainable system solutions.
Establishes processes for identifying recurring issues, analyzing root causes, and implementing longer-term solutions rather than relying on manual workarounds.
Develops and maintains HRIS documentation, procedures, knowledge resources, and training materials that support users and promote consistent system practices.

Projects, Optimization & Change

Leads and participates in complex HRIS and cross-functional technology projects from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, implementation, stabilization, and ongoing support.
Establishes project plans, priorities, requirements, testing strategies, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder responsibilities for HR technology initiatives.
Coordinates user acceptance testing and validates that solutions meet business requirements before implementation.
Partners with stakeholders to support effective communication, training, rollout, and adoption of new systems, enhancements, and processes.
Balances immediate operational needs with long-term system architecture and business objectives when evaluating solutions and priorities.

Reporting & Analytics

Partners with HR and business leaders to improve access to accurate, meaningful, and appropriately governed workforce information.
Oversees HRIS reporting capabilities, data extracts, interfaces, and recurring reporting processes.
Supports the development of reporting and analytics solutions that improve workforce planning, decision-making, operational visibility, and data consistency.
Helps establish common workforce data definitions and sources of truth across HR, Finance, and other functions.

Vendor & Partner Management

Serves as a key point of contact for HR technology vendors and implementation partners.
Manages vendor escalations, system issues, enhancement discussions, release planning, and technical coordination as appropriate.
Evaluates vendor capabilities and proposed solutions to ensure they align with Dudek’s requirements, security expectations, technology environment, and long-term strategy.

Team Leadership

Leads, develops, and supports HRIS team members, including Business Operations Analysts (HRIS) and other assigned resources, and manages onboarding and the support queue.
Establishes priorities and distributes work across system administration, projects, enhancements, reporting, integrations, and user support.
Builds team capability through coaching, documentation, cross-training, and knowledge transfer to reduce key-person dependencies and strengthen service continuity.
Promotes a collaborative, service-oriented approach while establishing clear accountability for system quality, responsiveness, and results.

Minimum Qualifications

Experience: 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in HRIS, HR technology, enterprise systems, or related systems roles, including recent experience with Dayforce or a comparable enterprise HCM platform (e.g., UKG, Oracle, Workday, SAP)
Demonstrated experience leading complex system implementations, integrations, enhancements, or transformation initiatives involving multiple business functions.
Experience working with integrations between HR, payroll, ERP, financial, recruiting, or other enterprise systems.
Strong understanding of HR data governance, system security, role-based access, integrations, testing, change management, and system controls.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex business requirements into effective, scalable system solutions.
Demonstrated experience working with technical and nontechnical stakeholders and communicating complex system concepts in clear business terms.
Experience leading or developing HRIS professionals and managing competing operational and project priorities.
Ability to work Pacific Time Zone business hours is required.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and partner effectively across departments in remote, hybrid, and office environments while maintaining productivity, accountability, and responsiveness.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting HRIS/ERP integrations or enterprise technology transformation initiatives.

Join the Department of Corrections (DOC) as an Intelligence Analyst 1 and take part in important work that supports safety and security. jobs.title: AI Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
The AI Business Intelligence Analyst - HR & Talent Acquisition converts workforce, candidate, recruitment, and recruiter-performance data into trusted dashboards, automated reporting, operational intelligence, and business recommendations. The role owns the full reporting lifecycle: requirements gathering, data validation, modeling, visualization, AI-assisted analysis, insight development, and executive communication.

The analyst partners with Talent Acquisition, HR, Operations, Workforce Management, Finance, Technology, and site leadership to identify hiring risks early, improve funnel conversion, strengthen recruiter effectiveness, reduce manual reporting, and support evidence-based workforce decisions

Primary Business Outcomes

Create one trusted source of truth for Talent Acquisition and priority HR performance measures.
Give leaders early visibility into class-fill risk, funnel leakage, candidate fallout, recruiter capacity, and workforce demand.
Shorten the time from data extraction to business action through automation and AI-assisted analysis.
Improve the quality and consistency of operational reviews, recruiter coaching, workforce planning, and executive decisions.
Establish responsible, human-reviewed use of generative AI across HR and recruiting analytics.

Key Accountabilities

1. HR and Talent Acquisition Business Intelligence

Design, build, test, publish, and maintain HR and recruiting dashboards, scorecards, exception reports, and business-review packs.
Develop end-to-end recruitment funnel reporting covering demand, requisitions, leads, contact attempts, screening, assessments, interviews, offers, requirements completion, onboarding, Day 1 attendance, and early-tenure outcomes.
Build workforce and people dashboards covering headcount, movement, attrition, absenteeism, retention, staffing gaps, productivity, and other approved HR measures.
Create data models, DAX measures, drill-through views, cohort analyses, segmentation, trend views, and recruiter or site-level performance cuts.
Translate HR and TA operating questions into clear business requirements, KPI definitions, calculation rules, report logic, and visualization designs.
Document data sources, metric owners, assumptions, refresh schedules, dependencies, filters, and approved sources of truth.

2. Recruiting Insights and Decision Support

Identify class-fill risk, lead aging, funnel bottlenecks, conversion gaps, candidate fallout, no-show patterns, recruiter workload imbalance, and sourcing-channel performance.

Data Sourcing and Coordination
Coordinate with business users, data owners, technology teams, and external data providers to obtain data required for analysis and reporting.

Data Collation and Preparation

Data Quality Checks and Issue Resolution
Perform completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity, and reconciliation checks before data is used for analysis or reporting.
Investigate data exceptions, compare results with source records, and work with data owners to resolve identified issues.
Maintain data quality checklists, issue logs, validation evidence, and clear records of corrections or assumptions.
Documentation and Team Support
Maintain data dictionaries, process notes, file inventories, data lineage records, and operating instructions.
Provide timely progress updates, communicate issues clearly, and support knowledge sharing within the team.
Learn new data tools, business concepts, and working methods as required, and apply feedback to improve the quality and efficiency of work.

Bachelor's degree or Polytechnic diploma in Data Science, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, or a related discipline, with relevant internship, academic project, or practical experience involving data sourcing, data preparation, ETL, and/or data quality management.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; exposure to SQL, Python, Power Query, or similar data preparation tools would be advantageous.
Basic understanding of data cleansing, data transformation, ETL processes, and data quality checks, coupled with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate discrepancies and validate information against source data.
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to work accurately with large datasets, maintain proper documentation, follow established processes, and meet agreed timelines.
Good written and verbal communication skills, with the professionalism and confidence to engage data owners and stakeholders effectively and work collaboratively across teams.
A proactive learning mindset, with the willingness to learn new tools, business concepts, and data processes.

Reporting to the Executive Director, IT Administration & Solution Delivery Center, this position provides comprehensive project management, process improvement, business analysis, business relationship management, and information systems administration for IT Division's enterprise systems and services as assigned. The position manages projects from concept through implementation and completion using both waterfall and agile methodologies.

The position serves as a business analyst and systems administrator for assigned functional areas and systems, developing a strong understanding of the supported units' business processes, operational needs, and technology requirements. Responsibilities include developing business and technical requirements; designing and building reports; supporting the requirements and design of queries, APIs, and system interfaces; performing and coordinating system testing and configuration; troubleshooting and resolving system issues; and serving as a liaison between IT and supported business units.

The position typically leads or participates as a member of cross-functional project teams and may also work independently as an individual contributor on assigned projects and initiatives. The role requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, collaborate with stakeholders across the organization, and provide timely and effective support for enterprise systems and services. Occasional evening and weekend work, overtime, and response to enterprise application outages or escalations may be required based on project and operational support needs.

Essential Functions

Project Management and Process Improvement

Act as lead project and process manager for your assigned customers and units.
Deliver projects on-time, on-budget, and in scope.
Plan and develop an accurate project portfolio in relation to the IT roadmap with leadership oversight and guidance.
Manage project schedules, budget, resources, communications, issues, risks, status reports, and implementation.
Work to improve business processes by mapping as is and future state maps and develop solutions.
Provide project and process support for the design, development, configuration, customization, and implementation of third-party and custom applications, systems, and services.
Manage and administer assigned systems and services, using appropriate business, analysis, and development tools.

Business Analysis and Business Relationship Management

Translate business needs into functional and technical requirements.
Perform documentation and business/technical analysis associated with system maintenance, modifications, and enhancements.
Design and author requirements, configurations, and specifications for systems/services, working closely with enterprise software engineers.
Document, coordinate, and participate in designing/planning/scheduling and UAT testing and system implementation.
Review new systems, modules, workflows for potential implementation.
Knowledge-share new and enhanced technologies to stakeholders.
Provide timely, responsive, and effective service to assigned customers and units.
Liaise with vendors and interact in a highly-paced and collaborative environment.

IT and Enterprise Systems Support

Provide device and system knowledge, and leadership for design, development, maintenance, and support of IT and higher education systems.
Manage and administer assigned systems and services, using appropriate business, analysis, and development tools.
Develop and facilitate complex reports using Argos and other business intelligence, analysis, and development tools.

Collaboration

Collaborate with the manager on unit goals and execute strategic initiatives as directed.
Communicate and collaborate with stakeholders for daily operations and to deliver/promote unit services/initiatives/projects.

Training

Oversee customer training programs within your assigned customers and units.
Collaborate with the IT Training Unit for logistics and administrative support during training periods.
Train FIT employees, with vendor assistance as needed, on applications, systems, and/or tools related to the unit's supported operations.

Documentation

Develop documentation (charters, implementation plans, user guides, knowledge based articles, etc.) for existing, modified, and/or new systems and services.

Experience managing technology projects and priorities and working with business stakeholders to identify and address technology needs.
Experience with process improvement, systems implementation, testing, or technical support.
Experience troubleshooting technical issues and working collaboratively with IT and business teams.
Strong written, verbal, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in a higher education IT environment.
Experience supporting or administering enterprise systems.
Experience developing custom reports, business intelligence solutions, automated workflows, or related data solutions.
Experience with project management methodologies and/or Agile practices.
PMP or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) certification.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Knowledge of project management, business analysis, process management, and technology implementation practices.
Knowledge of enterprise applications, systems administration, and technology-supported business operations.
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, troubleshooting, and complex problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate business needs into clear technical and functional requirements.
Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a collaborative environment.
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong interpersonal, organizational, documentation, and customer-service skills.
Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively to cross-functional project teams.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project; familiarity with Google Workspace and reporting/query tools.

jobs.title: Education Program Manager, Alpha - $200,000/year USD
jobs.description:
"the Great Educational Equalizer"

— Philosopher Johnathan Bi, on Alpha School

Alpha is hiring.

The best leaders don't measure success by what they accomplish themselves. They measure it by what the people around them achieve.

If you've managed programs, built high-performing teams, and held people accountable to ambitious goals, this role offers the chance to apply those skills where they'll shape the next generation.

At Alpha, students don't spend their days listening to lectures. They master academics through adaptive technology while Guides focus on coaching, motivation, accountability, and life skills. As a Lead Guide, you'll run the program that makes this model work—managing the people, the operations, and the outcomes, from coaching Guides to developing leaders to creating an environment where students consistently exceed expectations.

This is not an instructional coaching role, and it is not classroom teaching. You won't spend your days reviewing lesson plans or observing lectures because there aren't any. Instead, you'll build a culture of excellence by coaching Guides, leading engaging life skills workshops, and motivating students to achieve ambitious goals. Your success will be measured by the quality of students' experiences, your team's performance, and your ability to maintain uncompromising standards while inspiring others to meet them.

Alpha is building the world's best K-12 experience. That requires leaders who have already proven they can raise others' performance, make objective, data-driven decisions, and embrace bold new ideas rather than protecting outdated traditions. If that describes you, we'd love to meet you.

This role is currently open at select Alpha campuses: Boston, MA; Raleigh, NC; New York City, NY; Greenwich, CT; and Washington, DC.

If you're located in one of these markets—or excited to relocate—we'd love to hear from you. Exceptional candidates outside these locations are also encouraged to apply. As Alpha continues to grow, we regularly match outstanding leaders with opportunities across our expanding network of campuses.

What You Will Be Doing

Coaching Guides to consistently deliver exceptional student experiences while maintaining Alpha's high standards.
Leading engaging life skills workshops that develop communication, leadership, focus, and other real-world skills for K-12 students.
Motivating students to achieve ambitious learning goals and maximize progress in their self-directed academic programs.
Using data, observation, and coaching conversations to improve Guide performance and student outcomes.
Helping launch and establish new Alpha campuses by building a culture centered on excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What You Won’t Be Doing

Teaching traditional academic classes or delivering subject-matter lectures.
Writing lesson plans or designing curriculum.
Lowering standards to make students feel successful instead of helping them achieve real mastery.
Managing a team from behind a desk without regularly coaching students and Guides firsthand.
Preserving outdated practices simply because "that's how we've always done it."

Education Program Manager Key Responsibilities

Ensure every student consistently experiences Alpha's three promises by building high-performing Guides, delivering engaging life skills experiences, and maintaining uncompromising standards for student success.

Basic Requirements

Willingness to work on-site at an Alpha campus (relocation support available): Boston, MA; Raleigh, NC; New York City, NY; Greenwich, CT; Washington, DC
Bachelor's degree in Education, Psychology, Business, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
At least 5 years of experience in education, coaching, learning and development, or a related leadership role.
Experience leading and developing teams of five or more people, including hiring and making performance-based termination decisions.
Demonstrated success using data to drive performance improvements.
Experience working with children ages 5-14 in an educational, coaching, or developmental setting.
Experience building or launching a new team, program, business, school, or initiative, with willingness to help open a new campus from zero.
Willingness to work in a school model that rejects traditional lecture-based pedagogy.
Legal authorization to work in the United States.

Nice-to-have Requirements

Experience coaching youth through athletics, debate, camps, or extracurricular programs.
Exceptional public speaking and storytelling skills.
A track record of achieving high levels of academic, professional, or athletic performance.
Experience motivating teams through ambitious goals while maintaining high accountability.
A passion for challenging conventional education and helping shape a new model for K-12 learning.

About Alpha

Join the team building school around student growth

Alpha reimagines the school day around faster learning, stronger mentorship, and more time for students to build real-world skills.

Roles with real student impact:
Alpha hires teachers (guides), operators, admissions experts, school & curriculum leaders, and remote team members.

Education work that pays like it matters:
Alpha offers six-figure roles for people ready to help build a radically better school experience.

A culture built for builders:
Alpha is fast-moving, ambitious, and student focused. It’s for people who want to improve the system, not maintain it.

Alpha is where you can do the most meaningful work of your career.

There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!

Works with management and stakeholders to align priorities and goals using technical know-how in a fundamental engineering area or technical domain.

Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is scaling rapidly to meet global cloud and AI capacity demand. The Datacenter Design organization is expanding its technical program management capability to improve the speed, consistency, and predictability of data hall design delivery across Oracle’s global datacenter portfolio.

We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager – Data Hall Design
to drive complex, cross-functional infrastructure programs that support OCI capacity growth. This role will report to the Director of Technical Program Management for Data Hall Design and will operate as a senior individual contributor responsible for program execution, delivery governance, risk management, dependency tracking, process improvement, and stakeholder alignment.

Data Hall Design includes the physical infrastructure design workstreams required to prepare data halls for scalable OCI deployment, including structured cabling, fiber infrastructure, low-voltage systems, physical networking dependencies, construction handoffs, colocation readiness, and operational handoff milestones.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct people-management responsibilities. Success in this role requires technical depth, strong ownership, structured execution, executive-ready communication, and the ability to drive clarity across ambiguous, high-stakes infrastructure programs.

Responsibilities

Program Leadership and Governance

Drive planning and execution for complex Data Hall Design programs, including roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes.
Establish and maintain program mechanisms such as milestone reviews, dependency trackers, risk registers, executive updates, KPI dashboards, and escalation paths.
Translate OCI capacity priorities into clear execution plans that align design, construction, networking, colocation, operations, supply chain, vendor, and automation workstreams.
Prepare clear, concise updates for senior leaders, including delivery status, risks, trade-offs, mitigation plans, and decision recommendations.

Data Hall Design Delivery

Drive cross-functional execution across structured cabling, fiber infrastructure, low-voltage systems, physical networking dependencies, construction handoffs, colocation readiness, and operational handoff milestones.
Partner with design engineering teams to ensure deliverables support scalability, maintainability, performance, cost, deployment speed, and operational readiness.
Identify and resolve blockers that could impact design release dates, construction execution, network readiness, vendor delivery, colocation fit-out, or OCI capacity availability.
Maintain accurate program plans, schedules, dependency maps, decision records, and status reporting across assigned programs.

Process Excellence and Standardization

Use data, metrics, and operating reviews to improve schedule predictability, blocker resolution, design package readiness, and handoff quality.
Partner with tooling, workflow automation, dashboarding, and reporting teams to improve visibility, accountability, and execution performance.
Capture lessons learned and help improve repeatable program mechanisms across regions and design workstreams.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Engagement

Align stakeholders around goals, owners, timelines, risks, trade-offs, and decision points.
Influence without direct authority to drive accountability, unblock execution, and maintain urgency across multiple organizations.
Communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders at multiple levels, from detailed project reviews to senior leadership updates.

8+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Infrastructure Program Management, Datacenter Delivery, Engineering Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, or a related field.

Strong understanding of infrastructure delivery lifecycles, including design, construction, colocation readiness, networking dependencies, implementation readiness, operational readiness, and handoff to delivery or operations teams.
Experience building and operating program mechanisms such as roadmaps, milestone plans, dependency trackers, risk registers, executive reporting, dashboards, and KPI-based performance tracking.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-ready updates and driving alignment across technical and business teams.

Vil du tage ansvar for en omfattende IT-modernisering og skabe sammenhæng mellem forretning, processer og teknologi?
Recruit IT søger på vegne af Metz en erfaren og handlekraftig IT-projektleder, der kan tage ansvar for virksomhedens samlede digitale transformationsprogram – fra kortlægning og planlægning til implementering og forankring.

Metz er en familieejet virksomhed med omkring 60 medarbejdere. Gennem mange år har virksomheden udviklet systemer og arbejdsgange, der understøtter forretningen, men som i dag også skaber kompleksitet og afhængigheder.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central anvendes allerede til økonomistyring, mens Lotus Notes fortsat understøtter centrale processer inden for blandt andet lager, CRM og projektstyring.

Nu skal systemlandskabet moderniseres med ambitionen om mere sammenhængende, effektive og fremtidssikrede løsninger.
Du kommer ikke ind til et færdigt projekt med en fastlagt plan. Du skal være med til at skabe planen – og sikre, at den bliver gennemført.
Din rolle
Som IT-projektleder får du ansvaret for at planlægge, prioritere og drive det samlede transformationsprogram. Du skal sikre sammenhæng og fremdrift på tværs af projekterne og selvstændigt vurdere behovet for indsatser og kompetencer undervejs.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:
Kortlægge forretningsprocesser, systemer, integrationer og dataflows.
Indsamle og strukturere input fra forretningen og omsætte behov til konkrete systemkrav og næste skridt.
Bidrage til valg og samspil mellem ERP, CRM, lagerstyring og øvrige systemer.
Udarbejde og drive et samlet roadmap med prioriteringer, tidsplaner, ressourcer, budgetter og risici.
Drive projekterne gennem datamigrering, test, brugeraccept, idriftsættelse og overdragelse til drift.
Tage ejerskab for eksterne leverandører, koordinere interne interessenter og sikre kommunikation, oplæring og forankring.

Du skal kunne bevæge dig fra en workshop med lageret om deres daglige arbejdsgange til en teknisk dialog med en systemleverandør – og samtidig sikre, at projekterne kommer i mål.
Hvem er du?
Du har solid erfaring med IT-projektledelse eller transformationsledelse, gerne fra større ERP-implementeringer eller digitale transformationer, som du har været med til at drive fra start til slut.

Du forstår både teknologi og forretning og ved, at succesfulde IT-projekter handler lige så meget om mennesker og processer som om systemer.
Metz lægger især vægt på, at du:
Har dokumenteret erfaring med komplekse IT-projekter og gerne samlede transformationsprogrammer.
Har god forståelse for ERP, systemarkitektur, integrationer og dataflows.
Kan analysere forretningsprocesser og omsætte behov til konkrete løsninger.
Har erfaring med projektøkonomi, leverandørstyring og forandringsledelse.
Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt og skaber fremdrift, også når ikke alle svar ligger klar.

Erfaring med Business Central, CRM, WMS eller PIM er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
Metz søger ikke en udvikler eller en tung teknisk arkitekt, men en stærk projektleder med forretningsforståelse og teknisk indsigt til at drive den samlede transformation.
En rolle med reel indflydelse

Du refererer direkte til virksomhedens CFO og får en central rolle i Metz’ digitale udvikling. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med en erfaren kollega med fokus på data, BI og AI samt med forretningen og eksterne leverandører.

Metz tilbyder en uformel og familiepræget kultur med korte beslutningsveje, hvor du får mulighed for at tage ansvar, præge udviklingen og gøre en reel forskel.
Det er en stilling for dig, der motiveres af at skabe noget – og som gerne vil følge en transformation hele vejen fra de første analyser til de færdige løsninger.

new_jobs.title: Shipyard Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Canal Barge Company

Job Description

Shipyard Project Manager

I. Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Marine Shipyard Project Manager to plan, coordinate, and execute multiple concurrent vessel maintenance, repair, overhaul, and capital improvement projects across our Gulf Inland fleet. The successful candidate will independently manage a portfolio of shipyard projects, balancing safety, regulatory compliance, vessel reliability, budgets, and schedules.

This position works closely with Port Engineers, shipyards, vendors, vessel crews, Operations, and shoreside leadership. It requires strong marine technical judgment, financial accountability, and the ability to keep several complex projects moving without continuous on-site supervision at any single location.

II. Key Responsibilities

Multi-Project Management
Manage multiple major vessel maintenance, overhaul, and capital projects simultaneously across different shipyards and locations.
Develop and maintain project scopes, schedules, budgets, milestones, risk registers, and completion plans for each assigned vessel.
Prioritize competing project demands, coordinate resources and contractors, and identify conflicts or delays early.
Maintain clear portfolio-wide visibility of progress, cost forecasts, schedule variances, open decisions, and risks; provide regular updates to Engineering leadership.
Coordinate with shipyard and vendor personnel to ensure effective daily execution without requiring continuous on-site oversight.
undefined
Pre-Docking Planning & Procurement
Participate planning meetings with vessel crews and vessel management team members to define the job scope ahead of each shipyard availability.
Write detailed job scopes for major vendors and obtain estimates.
Coordinate with shipyards to schedule dry docking and other vendor activities.
Use planned and unplanned downtime to prepare for future outages, including scheduling inspections and pre-surveys.
Enter known issues and repairs into the planned maintenance system (PMS).
Work with the inventory control and procurement team to order and deliver materials and long-lead items and move spares to the locations where they are needed.
undefined
Project Execution & Technical Oversight
Plan and execute shipyard availabilities, including Internal Structural Examinations (ISEs), Certificate of Inspection (COI) renewals, propulsion overhauls, vessel modifications, and other major repairs.
Evaluate equipment conditions, vessel deficiencies, inspection findings, and proposed repairs to establish practical, technically sound scopes of work.
Oversee vendor performance, machinery installations, structural and piping work, testing, commissioning, and project closeout.
Ensure work complies with applicable safety, quality, USCG, and other regulatory requirements and is properly documented.
Identify technical issues and determine when to resolve independently and when to escalate significant operational, compliance, or financial risks.
Hold kickoff meetings with vendors and make sure every party has the current, detailed project list.
Serve as the primary contact between the vessel operator and the shipyard.
Make sure vessel crews understand their responsibilities during each project.
When on site, meet daily with vendors to plan the day’s work and lead daily safety huddles with vendors and crew.
Perform regular quality inspections and make sure defects are corrected promptly.
Coordinate and oversee sea trials, resolve any issues found, and confirm the vessel is fully operational before handover.
Complete the vessel handover and update all project documentation accordingly.
Budget, Vendor & Cost Management
Develop cost estimates and manage approved capital and maintenance budgets for multiple concurrent projects.
Obtain and evaluate competitive proposals; assess repair recommendations and change orders for necessity, scope, cost, and value.
Track commitments, invoices, change orders, actual spending, and estimated cost to complete; communicate variances promptly.
Validate contractor billing against approved work and supporting documentation.
Control unnecessary expenditure without compromising safe, reliable, or compliant vessel operation.
Communication, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Coordinate vessel availability and return-to-service plans with Operations and other stakeholders to minimize downtime.
Provide concise, accurate project updates and maintain organized scopes, approvals, inspection records, invoices, and closeout packages.
Lead post-project reviews and apply lessons learned to improve future execution, cost control, and project consistency.

III. Measurements of Success

Asset availability: percentage of time vessels are operational and ready for service.
Maintenance cost: variance between budgeted and actual project spending.
Project completion: percentage of projects completed on time and within budget.
Continuous improvement: number and impact of process improvements put in place.

IV. Required Qualifications

Demonstrated experience successfully managing multiple concurrent marine, shipyard, or industrial capital projects with direct accountability for budgets, schedules, contractors, and closeout.
Substantial experience in marine maintenance, vessel repair, marine engineering, shipyard operations, or a comparable technical environment.
Working knowledge of diesel propulsion, auxiliary machinery, piping, and related vessel systems.
Ability to interpret drawings, technical specifications, inspection findings, and vendor proposals.
Strong financial, organizational, communication, problem-solving, and prioritization skills.
Ability to travel regularly to shipyards, vessels, and vendor locations as required.
Preferred Qualifications
Inland towboat or commercial marine shipyard project experience.
Background as a Port Engineer, Chief Engineer, Shipyard Superintendent, Marine Project Manager, or similar role.
Marine engineering degree, technical education, or equivalent practical experience.
Familiarity with USCG Subchapter M, marine inspections, diesel engine overhauls, repowering, and major vessel modifications.
Experience with computerized maintenance management and project reporting systems.

VI. The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate takes ownership, makes well-supported decisions, challenges unnecessary costs, anticipates problems, and delivers multiple projects safely and effectively. Success requires both technical credibility and the discipline to control scope, schedule, and cost across an active project portfolio.

new_jobs.description:
Overview

Company Overview:

Join Allied Universal® Technology Services, a global leader in transforming the security industry. We integrate advanced technology — video surveillance, electronic access control, alarm monitoring and augmented solutions with physical security to help people feel safe. Whether you’re an installation technician, service technician, engineer, or project manager, you’ll discover rewarding opportunities to grow your career as part of a valued team.

Apply today and be phenomenal—build a meaningful career while protecting what matters most through innovative security technology.

Job Description

Allied Universal Technology Services is hiring a Project Manager to plan, organize, direct and control project-planning and performance activities for effective management of electronic security installation. Projects include, but are not limited to, all aspects of systems scheduling, field installation, commissioning QC/QA and financial success. Responsible for overall project budget management, project surveys, material procurement, project implementation and inspection scheduling. The Project Manager must be capable of executing portfolio of projects varying in size and complexity on time and within budget through effective communication, preparation and management.

Responsibilities

Maintain an active and thoughtful communication pattern with vendors, internal and external customers while balancing time versus profits to make sure efforts reflect and anticipated return (revenue, growth and customer retention)
Consistently and effectively determine, allocate, and maximize available resources through project planning to ensure the achievement of sales and project management objectives
Establish and maintain an in-depth knowledge of the industry and competitive practices as they relate to multiple markets
Implements changes in project, contract price and installation plans to include the estimation, development and submission of Change Orders
Support company's invoicing and collection efforts by not only ensuring all contractual terms and conditions are met initially, but by ensuring all invoicing is completed accurately and on time by aggressively monitoring the reports in ERP System and following up with customers management and customers on a consistent basis
Manage Project budget and project P&L responsibility
Prepares the project installation plan, determines goals, manages the plan, prepares and implements job procedures
Maintains construction schedules and coordinates task-scheduling with other trades
Maintains all records of job status, job changes and material flow
Defines project problems by working with financial, contract management and management tools to assure project profitability
Plans and schedules engineering, installation and subcontracting activities
Supervise installation labor and sub-contractors
Prioritize team workload to ensure quality results are delivered on time and within budget
Troubleshoot project issues and engage appropriate management and resources as needed to mitigate impacts
Develop fallback and contingency plans

Qualifications

High School Diploma required; Associates Degree preferred
At least six years of project management experience, electronic security industry experience is preferred
A proven track record and verified references relating to the ability to manager 4+ Million Dollar projects to schedule and budget.
Expert knowledge of PM techniques and tools, general knowledge of contract laws and regulations.
PMP from the Project Management Institute, preferred.
Ability to work independently, and perform tasks of moderate to high complexity, which requires knowledge of technical and business environments.
Factory certifications in relevant technology platforms is a plus (Software House, Lenel, Brivo, Open Options, Exacq, American Dynamics, Milestone, OnSSI, etc.).
Proficient with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project and SharePoint).
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with both internal and external customers
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Team Player with strong work ethic
Excellent follow-up and leadership skills
Strong analytical decision-making capabilities
Self-motivated with the ability to motivate and influence others
Must be able to manage multiple tasks while meeting strict deadlines
Experience in the security industry is preferred
Ability to conduct site walks and attend onsite customer meeting

Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, basic life, AD&D, retirement plan and disability insurance
Eight paid holidays annually, five sick days, and four personal days
Vacation time offered at an accrual rate of 3.08 hours biweekly; unused vacation is only paid out where required by law

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. Reporting to the Executive Director, IT Administration & Solution Delivery Center, this position provides comprehensive project management, process improvement, business analysis, and information systems support for the IT Division's infrastructure and services. The position manages projects from concept through implementation and completion using both waterfall and agile methodologies.

The position serves as a business analyst and systems administrator for assigned functional areas and systems, developing a strong understanding of the supported units' business processes, operational needs, and technology requirements. Responsibilities include developing business and technical requirements; designing and building reports; supporting the requirements and design of queries, APIs, and system interfaces; performing system testing and configuration; troubleshooting and resolving system issues; and serving as a liaison between IT and supported business units.

The position typically leads or participates as a member of cross-functional project teams and may also work independently as an individual contributor on assigned projects and initiatives. The role requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, collaborate with stakeholders across the organization, and provide timely and effective support for enterprise systems and services. Occasional evening and weekend work, overtime, and response to enterprise application outages or escalations may be required based on project and operational support needs.

Essential Functions

Project Management and Process Improvement

Act as lead project and process manager for your assigned customers and units.
Deliver projects on-time, on-budget, and in scope.
Plan and develop an accurate project portfolio in relation to the IT roadmap with leadership oversight and guidance.
Manage project schedules, budget, resources, communications, issues, risks, status reports, and implementation.
Work to improve business processes by mapping as is and future state maps and develop solutions.
Provide project and process support for the design, development, configuration, customization, and implementation of third-party and custom applications, systems, and services.
Manage and administer assigned systems and services, using appropriate business, analysis, and development tools.

Business Analysis and Business Relationship Management

Perform documentation and business/technical analysis associated with system maintenance, modifications, and enhancements.

Provide timely, responsive, and effective service to assigned customers and units.
Liaise with vendors and interact in a highly-paced and collaborative environment.

IT Infrastructure Support

Manage and administer assigned systems and services, using appropriate business, analysis, and development tools.

Collaboration

Communicate and collaborate with stakeholders for daily operations and to deliver/promote unit services/initiatives/projects.

Training

Train FIT employees, with vendor assistance as needed, on applications, systems, and/or tools related to the unit's supported operations.

Documentation

THE POSITION

Would you enjoy a career where you could lead statewide efforts that sustain healthy and productive forest ecosystems? The Department of Conservation & Natural Resources (DCNR) is seeking an innovative Silviculture Section Chief to lead our team overseeing critical forest management programs with the Bureau of Forestry. Your leadership will represent the sustainable stewardship legacy and accomplishment of the Pennsylvania Bureau of Forestry, coordinate the application of forest regeneration projects, direct the Bureau’s $20 million dollar plus annual timber sale program, foster positive relationships with our state’s forest product industry, guide and work towards continuously improving our silvicultural practices and timber program administration, seek and build collaborative networks among other state agencies and non-governmental partners to accomplish landscape-level conservation work on state forests and support silvicultural and forest products utilization-related research partnerships. Apply today to step into an influential role where your expertise directly shapes the future of Pennsylvania's forests.

DESCRIPTION OF WORK

This position directs statewide silviculture operations, timber program administration, and research coordination to support long-term forest sustainability. As the Silviculture Section Chief, you will perform the following duties:

Silvicultural Management: Review timber proposals, support and perform quality control of sale administration and regeneration fund project work, and review and improve silvicultural guidance utilized by the Bureau’s field staff
Program Oversight: Manage the business enterprise of bidding and contracting state forest timber sales, ensuring practices align with Commonwealth policies and management objectives
Technical Leadership: Provide expertise on applied silviculture techniques and coordinate research needs to advance sustainable forest management
Training Support: Develop and lead training for foresters, technicians, and program staff on silvicultural practices and timber sale procedures
Stakeholder Engagement: Represent the bureau at meetings and events to communicate forest management strategies and strengthen conservation partnerships
